SELECT

    trade_date,

    regime_label,

    ROUND(confidence_score::numeric, 2) AS confidence_score,

    volatility_level

FROM market_regimes

ORDER BY trade_date DESC

LIMIT 1;

SELECT

    ma.ticker_symbol,

    ROUND(ti.rsi::numeric, 2) AS rsi,

    ROUND(ti.macd::numeric, 4) AS macd,

    ROUND(ti.volatility::numeric, 4) AS volatility,

    ROUND(ti.daily_return::numeric, 4) AS daily_return,

    ROUND(ti.atr::numeric, 4) AS atr,

    ROUND(ti.sma_20::numeric, 2) AS sma_20,

    ROUND(ti.ema_20::numeric, 2) AS ema_20

FROM technical_indicators ti

JOIN market_assets ma
ON ti.asset_id = ma.asset_id

WHERE ti.rsi IS NOT NULL

ORDER BY

    ti.trade_date DESC,

    ti.volatility DESC,

    ABS(ti.daily_return) DESC

LIMIT 10;
